Agent Name: Bioinformatics_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Bioinformatics_Expert failed to identify the correct, stable reference genome assembly relevant to May 2020. Instead of providing the standard, widely used **CanFam3.1** (which is the primary reference assembly available and used in research up to and including May 2020), the expert provided links to newer assemblies (like CanFam4, which became available later in 2020) or research articles describing newer assemblies. The expert incorrectly prioritized "latest" or "new" assemblies over the standard reference that was actually the most relevant and accessible for general genomic analysis in May 2020. Furthermore, the provided links were to specific research papers describing the assemblies rather than direct links to the data files themselves, failing the constraint of providing "links to the files." The correct answer (ftp://ftp.broadinstitute.org/distribution/assemblies/mammals/dog/canFam3.1/) was missed entirely.
